test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'FORT' is written as '6301820' and 'PRICE' is written as '161818310'. How will 'FUTILE' be written in that language?
solution: The logic followed here is :- [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2a67b84e74c61e5ee924448c1dd33f5d869a5611f1f680023da067558eb2502.png] **Consonants alphabet positional value remains same.** **Vowels alphabet positional value increases × 2 times.** • 'FORT' is written as '6301820'.
